parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Republic Day 2026 at Kartavya Path

  • The 77th Republic Day celebrated 150 years of Vande Mataram; tableaux themes were 'Svatantrata ka Mantra – Vande Mataram' and 'Samriddhi ka Mantra – Aatmanirbhar Bharat'.
  • Chief guests: António Costa (President, European Council) and Ursula von der Leyen (President, European Commission).
  • 30 tableaux, 18 marching contingents and 13 bands took part.
  • Firsts: the Army's 'Battle Array Formation', the 61st Cavalry in combat gear, the new Bhairav Light Commando Battalion and Shaktibaan Artillery Regiment, and the rocket launcher 'Suryastra'.
  • Simran Bala became the first woman officer to lead an all-male CRPF contingent.
  • Tri-services tableau: 'Operation Sindoor: Victory through Jointness'.
  • Parade enclosures were named after rivers; at the Beating Retreat (29 January, Vijay Chowk) seating was named after musical instruments.

New trains, roads and cards

  • India's first Vande Bharat sleeper train, Guwahati (Kamakhya)–Howrah, was flagged off on 17 January from Malda Town; top speed 180 km/h, about 823 seats, Kavach-fitted.
  • Two Amrit Bharat Express trains started: Kamakhya–Rohtak and Dibrugarh–Lucknow (Gomti Nagar).
  • Foundation stone for the Kaziranga Elevated Corridor: 86 km four-lane Kaliabor–Numaligarh stretch of NH-715, about Rs 6,950 crore.
  • PM SVANidhi Credit Card launched on 23 January in Thiruvananthapuram: UPI-linked, interest-free revolving credit up to Rs 30,000 for street vendors who repaid the second loan.
  • NHAI set four Guinness World Records for continuous bituminous paving on the Bengaluru–Kadapa–Vijayawada corridor (NH-544G).

Governance and heritage

  • The 50th PRAGATI meeting reviewed big infrastructure projects and PM SHRI schools.
  • Granth Kutir at Rashtrapati Bhavan was opened by President Murmu on 23 January; it holds manuscripts and books in all 11 classical languages, supported by IGNCA under the Gyan Bharatam Mission.
  • Dharmendra Pradhan released 55 literary works in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam and Odia, published by the Central Institute of Indian Languages.
  • The Constitution in Santhali (Ol Chiki script) was released by the President; the script was created by Pandit Raghunath Murmu in 1925.
  • A Kushan-era Buddhist complex about 2,000 years old was found at Jehanpora, Baramulla (J&K) – the largest known Buddhist site in Kashmir.
  • UIDAI unveiled the Aadhaar mascot 'Uday'; the new Aadhaar app manages up to five profiles on one phone.
  • DGCA started the Electronic Personnel Licence (EPL) for pilots through the eGCA app.
PRAGATI: Pro-Active Governance and Timely Implementation; ICT platform launched in 2015 and chaired by the PM, linking the PMO, Union Secretaries and state Chief Secretaries.
Classical languages (11): Tamil, Sanskrit, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, Bengali. Tamil was the first (2004); the last five were added in 2024.

Green news

  • New Ramsar sites: Patna Bird Sanctuary (Etah, UP – UP's smallest bird sanctuary) and Chhari-Dhand (Kutch, Gujarat); India now has 98.
  • The second Project Dolphin survey began from Bijnor (UP), led by the Wildlife Institute of India.
  • Mission Mausam (Ministry of Earth Sciences) is building next-gen radars and supercomputing for better extreme-weather forecasts through IMD, IITM Pune and NCMRWF.
  • BNHS launched an Indian Skimmer conservation project in the Gangetic plains.

Portals and apps

  • PANCHAM: WhatsApp chatbot of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj (with UNICEF, Bhashini-enabled), launched 25 January.
  • Land Stack and Glossary of Revenue Terms launched under DILRMP; piloted in Chandigarh and Tamil Nadu.
  • PANKHUDI: single-window partnership portal of the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
  • SAMPANN pension system (Controller General of Accounts) now linked to UMANG and DigiLocker.
  • Ministry of Ports launched an online e-Port Clearance portal.

State firsts

  • Jharkhand notified rules to implement the PESA Act, 1996.
  • Tamil Nadu launched India's first DeepTech Startup Policy.
  • IGI Airport, Delhi became India's first water-positive airport; Delhi also started Atal Canteens.
  • India's longest glass skywalk bridge opened in Visakhapatnam.
  • The Rs 450 crore Matabari Tourism Circuit in Tripura links Tripura Sundari Temple, Chabimura and Dumboor Lake.

People remembered

  • Tilka Manjhi (real name Jabara Paharia), tribal rebel, killed Bhagalpur collector Augustus Cleveland in 1784 and was hanged on 13 January 1785.
  • Velu Nachiyar of Sivaganga ('Veeramangai') was the first queen to fight British rule and raised a women's army.
  • Kamya Karthikeyan, 18, became the youngest Indian to ski to the South Pole.
  • Deaths: Ajit Pawar (six-time Maharashtra Deputy CM, plane crash at Baramati), ecologist Madhav Gadgil (headed the Western Ghats Ecology Expert Panel, 2011), Suresh Kalmadi (ex-IOA chief), BBC's Mark Tully.
